verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Datadog CLI, datadog-ci, published in Datadog's own GitHub organization, so the core of the story is met. Evidence is thin, though: it is a single existence check with no documented commands, scope or agent/AI-workflow usage. Missing for 10: first-party CLI documentation describing its capabilities and coverage of the platform, evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
